create_data_logger: create a DataLoggerJsonLines instance to log structured data to a jsonl file
write_log_entry: write a dictionary of key-value pairs as a jsonl line with automatic timestamps
close_logger: close the DataLoggerJsonLines file handle and flush remaining data
flush_logger: flush buffered data to the jsonl output file without closing
init_logger_with_flush: initialize a DataLoggerJsonLines logger with custom path, name, and flush behavior
